title: JEE Advanced / Foundational Engineering Entrance
description: Rigorous foundational STEM curriculum covering algebra, coordinate geometry, calculus, mechanics, electromagnetism, and chemical principles.

steps.note: Master quadratic equations, binomial theorem, and progressions.
Conic sections, parabolas, ellipses, hyperbolas, and coordinate transformations.
Permutations, combinations, inclusion-exclusion, and generating functions.
Conditional probability, Bayes theorem, and discrete distributions.
Determinants, matrix inversion, and Gaussian elimination.
Limits, continuity, differentiation, and definite Riemann integration.
First-order linear ODEs and integrating factors.
Newton laws, friction, impulse, and work-energy theorem.
Center of mass, rotational inertia, torque, and Keplerian gravity.
Zeroth, First, and Second laws, Carnot engines, and entropy.
Coulomb law, Gauss law, Ampere law, and Biot-Savart law.
Faraday law, Lenz rule, and electromagnetic wave propagation.
Wavefront interference, diffraction, and geometric ray tracing.
Atomic structure, chemical equilibrium, and kinetics.
Reaction mechanisms, stereochemistry, and functional group synthesis.
Kirchhoff laws, RLC transients, and AC impedance analysis.
